cases.case4821: Case #4821: Inherited Land in Deceased Father's Name (Thiruvallur)

phone.micHelp: Click to speak or press Play Audio Demo
phone.sampleFarmerSpeech: Vanakkam sir, I am Selvaraj from Pakkam village, Thiruvallur. Our agricultural land is still in my late father Subramaniam's name who passed away in 2018. We have the 1994 registered sale deed and current patta, but when I approached the office for loan documents, they told me to get Patta Maruthal and a Varisu certificate. We don't know what papers to take to e-Sevai. Please guide us!
phone.agentResponse: Vanakkam Selvaraj ayya. Do not worry. Your pocket token is #4821. You have the Death Certificate and 1994 Sale Deed, but you must first obtain the Tahsildar Legal Heir Certificate (REV-114) at your nearest e-Sevai centre with a ₹60 fee. Take your father's death certificate, ration card, and family Aadhaar cards. Visit your local JanAI Café and mention code 4821.
phone.receiptSmsNotice: SMS delivered to +91 98401 *****. Bring father's death certificate, 1994 sale deed, and family ration card to JanAI Café.
